title.narrative: Cascade - Russian Federation (01-Jul-2021-30-Jun-2024)

description.narrative: Russian Federation, HIV, St. Petersburg charitable fund programs “Humanitarian action” (Humanitarian Action)This program has the following goals: To reduce HIV transmission and mitigate its impact on society by strengthening comprehensive responses to HIV, with a main focus on key populations. The objectives of this program are: To develop and implement exemplary comprehensive service-delivery models that strengthen the HIV Test-Treatment cascade, with a special focus on key populations. To strengthen sustainability of these service-delivery models by investing in partnerships and improved coordination and collaboration between civil society and State service providers; as well as investments in strengthening community systems (CSS)
